ModMetaData.name: [CP] Retro Joy
ModMetaData.author: Chicken Plucker
ModMetaData.description:
This mod will take you back to the past, to play some silly games that blast.. grass?

Adds the following:

- Comfy Boy armchair
- Tiny Retro tea table
- Rock 'em Sock 'em table
- Dungeons and Randies table
- Rimtendo Entertainment System

 Credits: dninemfive for updating this mod to 1.0
